notes.title: Love Hell is coming to Play NYC @ Anime NYC!
notes.notes:
🔥 [b]Descend into Love Hell: Where Bullets and Emotions Collide![/b] 🔥

[i]A Fiery Fusion of Visual Novel and Bullet Hell[/i]

Prepare for a heart-pounding adventure like no other! [b]Love Hell[/b] combines the intensity of bullet hell gameplay with the emotional rollercoaster of a visual novel. As you battle through waves of feelings, your ultimate goal is clear: win the heart of the boy you desire.

🌟 Come visit us!
Join us at Play NYC @ Anime NYC and experience the infernal fusion of love and bullets first hand. Play the game, meet the developer, and receive a free collectable card.

 Don’t miss out—your soulmate awaits!

🎁 Play NYC Exclusive:
For a limited-time only, if you stop by the booth and wishlist the game during the duration of the event, you will receive a free collectable card for the game!
